title: Mathesis ledger row
description: One claim in a SocrateAI stream's ledger. A claim absent from its stream's ledger has no tier and may not be cited (SPEC.md §0). Note: this schema constrains the shape of a single row; the SOUNDNESS of the ledger as a whole -- no claim filed above anything it transitively rests on -- is not expressible in JSON Schema and is enforced by scripts/verify.sh Gate 4, mirroring lean/Mathesis/TierCalculus.lean.

id.description: <STREAM>-<TIER>-<NNNN>. The tier letter is part of the identifier so that a promotion changes the id and a stale citation elsewhere becomes lexically wrong rather than silently wrong (SPEC.md §2.5).

tier.description: Citation strength. Must agree with the letter in `id` -- Gate 4 reports E-TIERMATCH otherwise.

statement.description: What is claimed, in one self-contained sentence. No adjectives (PLAN.md §2). A reader must be able to tell what would falsify it without opening the artifact.

evidence_kind.description: How the claim was established. This CAPS the tier: a `citation` row may not be filed above L however distinguished the source, and an `llm_output` row may not be filed above X however convincing the output (SPEC.md §0).

supports.description: Ids this claim rests on. The tier of this row must not exceed the tier of anything reachable through this list, transitively (MX-A-0003).

artifact.description: Path to the thing a gate can re-run: a Lean file and declaration names, a harness path, or a citation with the quoted theorem statement for Tier L.

stream.description: Human-readable stream name. Redundant with the id prefix, kept for legibility.

audited_by.description: Who signed the statement-adequacy audit, and when. Null means NOT AUDITED -- for a Tier A row that means the kernel checked the proof but nobody has yet certified the statement means what its gloss claims (SPEC.md §0). Never set this to a model.

supersedes.description: The id this row replaces, typically after a tier promotion changed the identifier. The trail is how a retraction can be traced.
